note: Read-only pre-flight captured before any write. Every figure here was read from production D1, the review-app MCP, the live Algolia write host, or the live site. Nothing in this file is inferred.

subsumption.verdict: The target's claims are fully subsumed by the survivor's.
subsumption.detail: The target asserts Documents and Directory & Contacts a_to_b in the procore->followup direction. The survivor asserts the same two data objects as `both` in the followup->procore direction, which covers the target's assertion and adds the reverse. This is the AECI-699 merge note reproduced from D1 alone, with no reliance on the upstream text.

guards.note: AECI-794 predicted orphansWithoutATwin would read 0. It reads 1. The datatool twin test matches on (source_product_id, target_product_id, mechanism_name), so it cannot see a reverse-orientation twin, and this pair also disagrees on mechanism_name (NULL vs 'FollowUp CRM "Push to Procore"'). claimsUniqueToOrphans reads 2 for the same reason plus an exact direction match, and a_to_b is not both. Both are false positives of an orientation-blind guard, not evidence against the ruling.

affectedProductsNote: Stored integration_count equalled the computed AECI-721 value for both products at measurement time, so the delete is the only thing moving them.

publicBefore.defect: The page renders two separate mechanism cards for one real integration. That is the user-visible symptom this retraction removes.

cache.evidence: apps/web/wrangler.jsonc declares an `exports` block for preview (L108) and staging (L175) only, not demo (L201) or production (L296). The live response carries `cache-control: private, no-store` with no Cf-Cache-Status, no Age and no Cache-Tag.
cache.consequence: A Cache-Tag purge is a no-op on production. Verification is by re-fetching the URLs, which is the same conclusion the AECI-593 Polycam run reached.

upstreamRetractionFeed.finding: The review app already ships a retraction feed. It is referenced nowhere in this repo. It is empty, so it journals deletions going forward only and cannot heal this strand. Filed as a follow-up: it is the AECi half of AECI-595 and it re-points AECI-796.
